content:
I have a small PR adding sum and product identities for nested powersetCards: #42487. Review much appreciated.

The main result is a double-counting identity: each r-subset of s is contained in exactly choose (|s| - r) (k - r) of its k-subsets. If anyone with an interest in finite combinatorics has a chance to take a look, I'd welcome feedback on the statements, naming, and AP (and general correctness).
